fruits.extendedStory: The church is Gothic. That means pointed arches and windows built to pull your eye upward. Its walls go back to about 1400. The name belongs to Saint Giles, and the kirk has carried it ever since. The Central Library stands a short walk down the hill.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Kirche ist gotisch gebaut. Das heißt: Spitzbögen und Fenster, die den Blick nach oben ziehen. Ihre Mauern gehen auf die Zeit um 1400 zurück. Den Namen hat sie von St. Giles, und sie trägt ihn seither. Bis zur Central Library ist es von hier nur ein kurzes Stück den Hügel hinunter.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The church is Gothic. That means pointed arches and windows built to pull your eye upward. Its walls go back to about 1400. The name belongs to Saint Giles, and the kirk has carried it ever since. The Central Library stands a short walk down the hill.

localizedStory.de: Die Hauptkirche Edinburghs trägt den Namen von St. Giles und stammt aus der Zeit um 1400.
localizedStory.en: Edinburgh's high kirk takes its name from Saint Giles and dates from around 1400.

fruits.name: St Giles' Cathedral
fruits.story: Edinburgh's high kirk takes its name from Saint Giles and dates from around 1400.

fruits.extendedStory: The building went up to a design by Benson and Forsyth. It opened its doors in 1998. Greyfriars Kirk stands a short walk away, behind the museum. Between the two you cross from one century into another in a few steps.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Bau entstand nach einem Entwurf von Benson und Forsyth. Eröffnet wurde er 1998. Damit ist er jünger als fast alles ringsum. Die Greyfriars Kirk steht nur ein kurzes Stück entfernt, hinter dem Museum. Zwischen beiden wechselst du in wenigen Schritten das Jahrhundert.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The building went up to a design by Benson and Forsyth. It opened its doors in 1998. Greyfriars Kirk stands a short walk away, behind the museum. Between the two you cross from one century into another in a few steps.

localizedStory.de: Benson und Forsyth entwarfen dieses Museum, das 1998 eröffnet wurde.
localizedStory.en: Benson and Forsyth designed this museum, which opened in 1998.

fruits.name: National Museum of Scotland
fruits.story: Benson and Forsyth designed this museum, which opened in 1998.

fruits.extendedStory: Before the kirk there was a Franciscan monastery on this ground. The church was built on the site the friars left behind. An original copy of the Covenant is kept in the kirk's own museum. Document and room have stayed together ever since. The National Museum of Scotland is a short walk away.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Vor der Kirche stand auf diesem Boden ein Franziskanerkloster. Die Kirche wurde auf dem Platz gebaut, den die Mönche hinterließen. Eine Originalabschrift des Covenant liegt heute im kircheneigenen Museum. Dokument und Raum sind also beisammen geblieben. Bis zum National Museum of Scotland ist es nur ein kurzes Stück.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Before the kirk there was a Franciscan monastery on this ground. The church was built on the site the friars left behind. An original copy of the Covenant is kept in the kirk's own museum. Document and room have stayed together ever since. The National Museum of Scotland is a short walk away.

localizedStory.de: 1638 wurde hier vor der Kanzel der National Covenant unterzeichnet.
localizedStory.en: In 1638 the National Covenant was signed here, in front of the pulpit.

fruits.name: Greyfriars Kirk
fruits.story: In 1638 the National Covenant was signed here, in front of the pulpit.

fruits.extendedStory: Four years of work, from 1840 to 1844. Stand right at the base and look up through the middle of it. You cannot hold the foot and the tip in one glance from here. Walk on and the National Gallery comes up along the same gardens.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Begonnen wurde 1840, fertig war das Denkmal 1844. Stell dich unten an die Princes Street und schau innen die Mitte hinauf. Von hier bekommst du Fuß und Spitze nicht zugleich ins Auge. Die National Gallery liegt am selben Grünzug, nur ein kurzes Stück weiter.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Four years of work, from 1840 to 1844. Stand right at the base and look up through the middle of it. You cannot hold the foot and the tip in one glance from here. Walk on and the National Gallery comes up along the same gardens.

localizedStory.de: Schau von der Princes Street hinauf: gebaut wurde hier zwischen 1840 und 1844.
localizedStory.en: Look up from Princes Street: this one went up between 1840 and 1844.

fruits.name: Scott Monument
fruits.story: Look up from Princes Street: this one went up between 1840 and 1844.

fruits.extendedStory: The woman who started this crossed from the West Indies in 1827. By 1835 she had an observatory open to the public. In 1853 she carried the business, by then Short's Observatory, up to the Royal Mile. Patrick Geddes later renamed it the Outlook Tower and made it somewhere to learn.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Maria Theresa Short kam 1827 aus Westindien nach Edinburgh. 1835 eröffnete sie eine Sternwarte für das Publikum. 1853 zog sie ihr Geschäft, inzwischen Short's Observatory genannt, hinauf auf die Royal Mile. Später benannte Patrick Geddes das Haus in Outlook Tower um und machte einen Lernort daraus.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The woman who started this crossed from the West Indies in 1827. By 1835 she had an observatory open to the public. In 1853 she carried the business, by then Short's Observatory, up to the Royal Mile. Patrick Geddes later renamed it the Outlook Tower and made it somewhere to learn.

localizedStory.de: Maria Theresa Short eröffnete hier 1835 ihre Sternwarte.
localizedStory.en: Maria Theresa Short opened her popular observatory here in 1835.

fruits.extendedStory: The architect was George Washington Browne, and the building dates from 1890. You find it on McConnachie's Close, below the line of the High Street. Walk up the hill from here and St Giles' Cathedral comes into view.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Architekt war George Washington Browne, und das Haus stammt von 1890. Du findest es am McConnachie's Close, unterhalb der Linie der High Street. Der Boden fällt hier stark ab, und die Bibliothek nimmt den Hang mit. Gehst du den Hügel hinauf, steht bald St Giles' Cathedral vor dir.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The architect was George Washington Browne, and the building dates from 1890. You find it on McConnachie's Close, below the line of the High Street. Walk up the hill from here and St Giles' Cathedral comes into view.

localizedStory.de: George Washington Browne entwarf diese Bibliothek, die aus dem Jahr 1890 stammt.
localizedStory.en: George Washington Browne designed this library, which dates from 1890.

fruits.name: Central Library
fruits.story: George Washington Browne designed this library, which dates from 1890.

fruits.extendedStory: The man who certainly lived here was James Mossman, goldsmith to the queen. He shared the house with his wife, Mariotta Arries, and stood with the Queen's Men. The building itself goes back to 1490. Tradition says John Knox lodged here in the months before he died in November 1572. The name stuck.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Sicher gewohnt hat hier James Mossman, Goldschmied der Königin. Er teilte das Haus mit seiner Frau Mariotta Arries und hielt zu den Queen's Men. Der Bau selbst geht auf 1490 zurück. Die Überlieferung sagt, John Knox habe hier in den Monaten vor seinem Tod im November 1572 gewohnt. Der Name ist geblieben.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The man who certainly lived here was James Mossman, goldsmith to the queen. He shared the house with his wife, Mariotta Arries, and stood with the Queen's Men. The building itself goes back to 1490. Tradition says John Knox lodged here in the months before he died in November 1572. The name stuck.

localizedStory.de: Sicher gewohnt hat hier James Mossman. John Knox, dessen Namen es trägt, ist vielleicht nur eine gute Geschichte.
localizedStory.en: James Mossman lived here for certain. John Knox, whose name it carries, may just be a good story.

fruits.name: John Knox House
fruits.story: James Mossman lived here for certain. John Knox, whose name it carries, may just be a good story.

fruits.extendedStory: Eviction created this congregation. James VII claimed their older meeting place, wanting it for his Order of the Thistle. Suddenly nobody hereabouts had anywhere to gather. Funding arrived sideways. A merchant, Thomas Moodie, had willed money to the Crown in 1649, and James spent that legacy hereabouts. Worship began on this ground in 1691. Soldiers adopted it too, so the garrison up on the rock counts this their own.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Diese Gemeinde entstand durch einen Umzug. Jakob VII. wollte ihr altes Haus beim Palast für seinen Distelorden. Damit standen die Leute der Canongate ohne Kirche da. Bezahlt wurde der Neubau aus einem Vermächtnis: Der Kaufmann Thomas Moodie hatte es 1649 der Krone hinterlassen. 1691 ging hier auf. Auch Soldaten zählen es zu ihrem, denn es ist zugleich die Kirche der Burg oben am Hügel.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Eviction created this congregation. James VII claimed their older meeting place, wanting it for his Order of the Thistle. Suddenly nobody hereabouts had anywhere to gather. Funding arrived sideways. A merchant, Thomas Moodie, had willed money to the Crown in 1649, and James spent that legacy hereabouts. Worship began on this ground in 1691. Soldiers adopted it too, so the garrison up on the rock counts this their own.

localizedStory.de: Adam Smith liegt auf diesem Kirchhof, ein paar Schritte neben der Canongate.
localizedStory.en: Adam Smith rests in this kirkyard, a few steps off the Canongate.

fruits.name: Canongate Kirk
fruits.story: Adam Smith rests in this kirkyard, a few steps off the Canongate.

fruits.extendedStory: Amateurs commissioned this. Calling themselves the Edinburgh Musical Society, they had wearied of renting somewhere to play. Robert Mylne drew them something permanent. Nowhere in Scotland was raised earlier for the sole business of performing. He shaped an ellipse and refused it windows entirely. Daylight arrives through the oval cupola alone, so nothing outside can tug your eyes off the players. The university took it over in 1959.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Bezahlt hat das ein Verein von Liebhabern. Sie nannten sich Edinburgh Musical Society und hatten das Mieten von Räumen satt. Robert Mylne entwarf ihnen etwas Eigenes. Früher wurde in Schottland kein Saal eigens zum Konzertieren gebaut. Den Raum formte er als Ellipse, ganz ohne Fenster. Licht fiel allein durch die ovale Kuppel. Nichts von draussen sollte den Blick von den Spielenden ziehen. 1959 kaufte die Universität das Haus.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Amateurs commissioned this. Calling themselves the Edinburgh Musical Society, they had wearied of renting somewhere to play. Robert Mylne drew them something permanent. Nowhere in Scotland was raised earlier for the sole business of performing. He shaped an ellipse and refused it windows entirely. Daylight arrives through the oval cupola alone, so nothing outside can tug your eyes off the players. The university took it over in 1959.

localizedStory.de: Robert Mylne entwarf diesen Saal 1763; er trägt den Namen der heiligen Cäcilia.
localizedStory.en: Down Dickson's Close there is a concert room from 1763, named for Saint Cecilia.

fruits.name: St Cecilia's Hall
fruits.story: Down Dickson's Close there is a concert room from 1763, named for Saint Cecilia.

fruits.extendedStory: Prince Albert set the foundation stone down on 30 August 1850. Count the porticoes: two, one north, one south. They betray a house that spent decades leading a double life. Sliced lengthwise, its eastern half hosted Academy exhibitions while the western half held the nation's own paintings. Everything shifted in 1912. The Academy moved north into the former Royal Institution, leaving the whole place to the pictures.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Am 30. August 1850 setzte Prinz Albert den Grundstein. Zähl die Säulenvorbauten: zwei, einer nach Norden, einer nach Süden. Sie verraten ein Haus, das lange ein Doppelleben führte. Der Länge nach geteilt, zeigte der Ostflügel die Ausstellungen der Akademie. Im Westflügel hing die nationale Sammlung des Landes. So blieb es viele Jahrzehnte. 1912 änderte sich das. Die Akademie zog nach Norden ins alte Royal Institution, und das Haus gehörte fortan den Bildern.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Prince Albert set the foundation stone down on 30 August 1850. Count the porticoes: two, one north, one south. They betray a house that spent decades leading a double life. Sliced lengthwise, its eastern half hosted Academy exhibitions while the western half held the nation's own paintings. Everything shifted in 1912. The Academy moved north into the former Royal Institution, leaving the whole place to the pictures.

localizedStory.de: William Henry Playfair entwarf diese Galerie am Mound; eröffnet wurde sie 1859.
localizedStory.en: Cross the Mound and you pass its front: a gallery here since 1859, drawn by William Henry Playfair.

fruits.name: National Gallery
fruits.story: Cross the Mound and you pass its front: a gallery here since 1859, drawn by William Henry Playfair.

fruits.extendedStory: Follow his eyes uphill. The kilted figure sits with a rifle over his knees, caught just before rising, staring toward the castle. Tait MacKenzie shaped him. Walk the wall behind: fifty feet of stone carrying a relief twenty-five feet long. A pipe band heads the procession. Miners come next, then shepherds with a sheep dog, fishermen carrying nets, clerks, children. Folk of Scottish blood living in America sent the whole thing over as a gift.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Folge seinem Blick den Hügel hinauf. Die Gestalt im Kilt sitzt da, das Gewehr über den Knien, kurz vorm Aufstehen. Tait MacKenzie hat sie geformt. Geh die Mauer dahinter ab, fünfzehn Meter Stein mit einem langen Relief. Voran zieht eine Pfeifenkapelle. Dann kommen Bergleute, Hirten mit Hütehund, Fischer mit Netzen, Kontoristen, Kinder. Geschickt haben es Menschen schottischer Herkunft in Amerika, als Geschenk.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Follow his eyes uphill. The kilted figure sits with a rifle over his knees, caught just before rising, staring toward the castle. Tait MacKenzie shaped him. Walk the wall behind: fifty feet of stone carrying a relief twenty-five feet long. A pipe band heads the procession. Miners come next, then shepherds with a sheep dog, fishermen carrying nets, clerks, children. Folk of Scottish blood living in America sent the whole thing over as a gift.

localizedStory.en: Finished in 1927, and easy to walk straight past.
